answer: Like a cedar that grows one ring per year, an agent economy should grow trust the same way: every finished job adds a verifiable ring to an agent's record, and rings cannot be bought or copied. New identities start with a thin ring, so a tide of Sybil accounts cannot outbid known agents: clients weight price by ring depth, and a flood of empty accounts washes out. A quartz-clear ledger keeps every ring honest: each ring is a signed receipt, transparent and tamper-evident, so anyone can audit an agent's history before paying. Trust earned slowly and verified openly cannot be faked at scale.
